My experience

From research to roadmap

"I don't believe in designing for users I haven't met."

I joined STLFLIX in September 2024 as UX Research Lead, running research to define personas, map journeys, and understand subscriber behavior, generating insights that shaped the product experience and surfaced new business opportunities. I also supported research for the Advanced team, exploring new applications and trends for the 3D printing market.

As the company's ecosystem expanded, I stepped into the role of Product Manager for STLAI, an AI-powered 3D product customization platform, connecting Product Design, Prompt Engineering, Development, Quality and Customer Success across the full development cycle. My work spans roadmap construction and prioritization, coordinating weekly releases, defining customizer navigation flows, validating deliverables, analyzing metrics, running user and market research, and continuously identifying opportunities to evolve the product, all within a fast-paced, AI-driven environment that demands frequent delivery and data-informed decisions.

Led an innovation project for trade marketing, from discovery through pilot preparation with clients, plus design-process and early leadership initiatives for my chapter.

2015 – 2021 · Whirlpool

Six and a half years across the full UX/UI process: research, data analysis, alternative exploration, and concept validation with users.

2014 – 2015 · SENAI

Case studies, in order

Twelve projects, one thread: understand first, then build

01 STLAI, Platform Development, Research & Product Strategy
STLFLIXGlobal2025 – 2026

From a lean team of five to a tripled squad, shipping a new AI customizer every week.

I've been part of STLAI since the platform's inception, watching both the product and the team evolve over this first year has been genuinely rewarding. We started with a lean team: a Product Manager (me), a Designer, a Prompt Engineer, and two Developers. Today the team has tripled, releasing a new customizable product collection every single week.

Early on, generative-AI 3D models didn't yet deliver the realism users expected. Through a steady rhythm of research, experimentation and testing, we pushed generation quality forward while tracking the latest advances in the technology, and, in parallel, added manual customization tools so the experience didn't depend on AI alone while it matured.

One of my biggest responsibilities has been building and maintaining a market-driven roadmap, grounded in constant research: competitive benchmarking, physical store visits, marketplace research, trend analysis, and behavioral studies, so every product decision is backed by real data and real market opportunity.

As Product Manager, I coordinate the entire release process: construction and prioritization of the roadmap, market and user research, navigation-flow design for each customizer, testing and approval before launch, usage-metric analysis, and proposing new features to drive the platform's growth. After a year of continuous evolution, STLAI shows consistent month-over-month growth, the result of research, innovation, frequent delivery, and data-driven decisions working together.

02
STLFLIX2024 – 2025 · Global

Personas STLFLIX & User Journey Mapping

My first challenge at STLFLIX was answering a foundational question: who were our users, and how did they actually use the platform? I revisited past Customer Success interviews, then designed and ran a full qualitative study, building the interview script with input from across the company, recruiting participants, and conducting in-depth interviews with a mostly US-based subscriber base.

Every interview was recorded, transcribed and organized in Dovetail. The result was a complete persona report: a primary persona, secondary profiles, and new market opportunities, including insigths that fed into the idea for STLAI, followed by full journey maps covering context, motivations, expectations, in-product experience, and perceived value.

ResultA persona & journey framework that became the reference point for product, UX, and prioritization decisions.
Desk ResearchCSD MatrixIn-depth InterviewsDovetailMiro

Involves TechnologyJan – Dec 2022 · Brazil

Commercial Agreements Feature (Web & Mobile)

Most companies have no consolidated way to track trade agreements between industry and retail, and globally, only 32% of that invested money ever returns value (McKinsey, 2019). I led this innovation project which aimed to find a solution to track end to end commercial agrements path. From discovery through MVP: desk research, a CSD Matrix, benchmarking, and online validation, then built the flows and high-fidelity prototypes myself in Figma.

ResultFirst phase shipped with strong feedback from the food industry vertical, with a clear backlog for expansion into other sectors.

Cooking Strategy Sprint

By mapping every cooking product and configuration globally, we could evaluate how to reduce complexity across regions, speeding up development and improving margins, without breaking the experience for any single culture's cooking habits. With two colleagues, I organized a week-long cross-functional sprint to turn all that research into one global cooking portfolio.

Whirlpool2018 – 2021 · Global

UX Parameters

I led this project, which centered on building a repository of studies and knowledge covering usability, ergonomics, and safety, providing guidance and best practices to establish the prerequisites needed for product development. It gave new projects a running start and grounded them in evidence, while also supporting projects already in progress as they went through testing and approvals with the team.

Brastemp & Whirlpool Stoves

Complete renewal of 30" Brastemp stoves in Brazil and a new premium Whirlpool line for Mexico. 10
Whirlpool2017 – 2018 · Brazil & Mexico

Brazil & Mexico In-Home Research

To design winning products for both markets, we needed to understand each country's habits and culture, not assume they were interchangeable. We ran in-home studies with 8 interviews per country, observing users cooking and doing daily chores. I've worked closely with engineering to sponsor the research directly, as well to share all the findings with their team.

ResultA complete cross-country cooking journey, user profiles, and platform guidelines for new product development.
Ethnographic InterviewsCultural ProbeConcept CardsUser Journeys
11
Whirlpool2016 · Bogotá & Barranquilla, Colombia

Colombia In-Home Research

Most products shipped to Colombia were simply relabeled versions of what sold in Brazil, but the UX team knew there could be cultural differences and it could impact on sales. With the sponsor of our leadership, we did in-home research across two cities chosen for their contrasting climate and geography, 8 interviews on each city, to understand what this market actually needed.

ResultThere were significant differences in user habits, which directly contributed to defining a refrigeration platform for the Colombian market, optimizing the refrigerator's internal layout and features based on actual usage data.
Research LeadershipEthnographic InterviewsUser Journeys
12 Extra, off the roadmap

SilSou Ceramics

A craft that runs on the same instinct as research: pay attention to the material.

I grew up between the urban center and the countryside, and since I was a little girl I've always been fascinated by manual and artisanal work, and by contact with nature and animals. That essence has carried into my ceramics practice since 2016, a creative outlet where I try to imprint personality and technical knowledge into handmade artifacts. My passion for ceramics gave birth to SilSou, a project I'm genuinely proud of and have taken on as a craft.
